blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines – Government offices in the Davao Region awarded 49 food service contracts to a corporation linked to Vice President Sara Duterte, according to a Philippine Government Electronic Procurement System (PhilGEPS) official who testified on Tuesday. Rendell Sopeña, chief of the PhilGEPS Electronic Government Procurement Operations Division, disclosed the contracts while taking the witness […]...
